events.note: In his marriage record to Karolina Hirsz from 1822, the priest noted that his age was confirmed through metrical records from the Evangelical Church in Września. The earliest known metrical records from the Evangelical Church in Września are from 1818 (Source: APP), making it unlikely that a birth record will ever be found. Bogusław Celmer’s birth date, along with the birth date for his sibling Bogumił Celmer have been taken from a population register created in 1845. This record indicates that the Evangelical population may have reported births/deaths/marriages to the Evangelical Church in Września for a short period of time in the first few years of the 19th century.
